recipes.name: Badenjan Buranie
recipes.subtitle: Eggplants and Peppers
recipes.description: A traditional Afghan appetizer of fried eggplants and peppers layered with tomato puree and yogurt sauce

steps.instruction: Cut eggplants and tomatoes into 1 cm thick slices. Slice onions and red bell peppers into 1/4" rings.
steps.tips: Keep eggplant slices uniform for even cooking

steps.instruction: Pour 4 tbsp of oil into a frying pan. Fry eggplant a few at a time, until lightly browned on each side.
steps.tips: Add more oil as needed. When eggplant releases oil, it's ready to plate

steps.instruction: When all eggplant slices are fried, place a layer of eggplant in the frying pan. On top, place onion rings and pepper rings. Repeat layers.
Pour tomato puree and water into pan. Cover and simmer lightly for 15 minutes, until eggplant is tender.
steps.tips: Don't overcook - eggplant should remain slightly firm

steps.instruction: Combine yogurt with crushed garlic and salt in a separate bowl. Mix well.
steps.tips: Use fresh garlic for best flavor

steps.instruction: Spread half of yogurt sauce on serving dish. Gently lift vegetable layers and place on top. Top with remaining yogurt and vegetable juices.

recipes.name: Aush
recipes.subtitle: Pasta with Yogurt & Ground Beef
recipes.description: High-protein Afghan noodle dish with beef sauce and yogurt, traditionally served in winter

steps.instruction: In large pot, pour 6 cups chicken broth, 1 tbsp oil and the noodles. Cook uncovered for 3 minutes.
Wash and chop spinach. Drain chickpeas and kidney beans.
Add chopped spinach and beans to pot. Cook for 5 minutes. Set mixture aside.
steps.tips: Keep warm while making meat sauce

steps.instruction: In frying pan, heat 3 tbsp oil. Fry finely chopped onions and crushed garlic until brown.
Add ground meat. Use spatula to break up meat and mix until juices evaporate slightly, about 5 minutes.
steps.tips: Don't overcook - meat should be tender

steps.instruction: Add salt, pepper, turmeric, coriander seeds, tomato puree and 1 cup water. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes.
Finish meat sauce with fresh chopped coriander and dried mint.
To serve: Place noodle mixture in soup bowl. Add meat sauce, yogurt and stir well. Garnish with fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Mantu
recipes.subtitle: Stuffed Steam Pasta
recipes.description: Traditional Afghan dumpling pasta with lamb filling, topped with yogurt and garlic oil sauce

steps.instruction: Finely chop onions and mix all filling ingredients together. Set aside.
steps.tips: Use lean lamb for healthier option

steps.instruction: Mix all dough ingredients well and knead for 5 minutes. Let dough sit for 10 minutes.
steps.tips: Dough should be smooth and slightly elastic

steps.instruction: Divide dough into 20 balls and roll out each ball to about 2mm thick pieces. Cut into 5cm squares.
steps.tips: Use consistent sizes for even cooking

steps.instruction: Place 1 tbsp of meat mixture onto center of each dough square.
Take two opposite corners of dough and seal with wet fingers. Repeat with other corners, creating a neat parcel.
steps.tips: Seal tightly to prevent filling from escaping

steps.instruction: Lightly oil the surface of a multi-level steamer. Place Mantu in a single layer with space between each.
Brush top of each Mantu with oil. Cover steamer and steam for 20 minutes on high heat.
Heat 3 tbsp olive oil with crushed garlic and turmeric powder for 1 minute.
Cover serving dish base with half the yogurt. Arrange Mantu in single layer. Top with remaining yogurt.
steps.tips: Use thick, creamy yogurt for best results

steps.instruction: Drizzle warm garlic oil topping on Mantu and garnish with chopped coriander.

recipes.name: Sambosa
recipes.subtitle: Stuffed Baked Pastries
recipes.description: Afghan pastry pockets filled with spiced ground beef, often eaten with tea for breakfast or snacks

steps.instruction: Place flour in mixing bowl. Cut up butter and rub gently into flour with fingertips until mixture feels like breadcrumbs. Add salt.
steps.tips: Keep butter cold for flaky pastry

steps.instruction: Slowly add 2 cups water and knead until dough is smooth. Add more water if needed. Let dough rest.
steps.tips: Smooth dough is key for workability

steps.instruction: Roll out dough with rolling pin and cut out small circles using a cup or cookie cutter. Set aside on floured surface.
Heat oil in pan. Add ground meat and stir quickly so it doesn't clump.
While meat cooks, chop onion. Allow juices from meat to evaporate.
Add chopped onions, stirring for a few minutes until brown. Add crushed garlic.
Add ground cardamom seeds, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and let cool.
Place 1 tbsp of meat mixture on bottom half of dough circle. Fold over into semi-circle. Crimp edges with fork.
steps.tips: Seal tightly so filling doesn't escape during baking

steps.instruction: Place sambosas on baking tray. Bake for 10-15 minutes in 210°C oven until light golden color.
Serve hot or cold with chutney, sweet and sour sauce, or yogurt sauce.
steps.tips: Sambosas are traditionally served with sweet powdered cardamom and pistachios

recipes.name: Chapli Kebab
recipes.subtitle: Ground Beef Kebab
recipes.description: Southeastern Afghan specialty kebab made with ground beef and fresh herbs

steps.instruction: Wash and chop spring onion and coriander leaves finely.
In a large bowl, add ground beef, spring onion, coriander leaves, flour, egg and all spices. Mix well.
Cut tomatoes into small cubes and add to bowl. Mix gently.
Heat 1 tsp oil on non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Form medium-size patties using 2 tbsp of mixture. Add patties to hot skillet.
Cook both sides to preference. Typically cooked well done.
Serve with lemon, onion rings, salad, rice, or bread.

recipes.name: Bangers and Mash
recipes.subtitle: Saucisse et Pomme de Terre
recipes.description: Simple, practical dinner from 'The Hopeless Cooks Cookbook' - sausages and potatoes that even beginners can master

steps.instruction: Simmer sausages in water for about 10 minutes until cooked. Remove skins.
Put sausages in a frying pan on medium heat to brown.
steps.tips: This adds nice color and flavor

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until cooked. Can mash or serve as chunks.
steps.tips: Chunks fill you up faster than mash

steps.instruction: Serve before the delicious smell forces everyone to attack the kitchen!
steps.tips: Serve hot with gravy if desired

recipes.name: Cornbread with Cheese and Kaymak
recipes.subtitle: Yugoslav Appetizer
recipes.description: Golden cornbread with melted cheese and creamy kaymak, served warm

steps.instruction: Mix maize flour and semolina together.
Crush cheese well. Add kaymak or sour cream to cheese.
To cheese mixture add egg yolks, oil, and mineral water. Mix all well.
Add mixed corn flour and semolina to wet mixture.
Whisk egg whites stiffly and blend them in carefully.
steps.tips: Whipped eggs create light, airy cornbread

steps.instruction: Grease baking pan well with oil. Pour mixture into it.
Bake in oven preheated to 175°C for about 50 minutes.
steps.tips: Test with fork - should come out clean

steps.instruction: Cool cornbread a little, then cut into squares. Serve with sheep or cow cheese, cheese spread or yogurt.

recipes.name: Cheese and Sour Cream Cakes
recipes.subtitle: Romanian Appetizer
recipes.description: Crispy fried cheese cakes served warm with sour cream

steps.instruction: Pass cheese through sieve or crush well.
Beat butter well. Add egg yolks one by one.
Add cheese, sour cream, whole egg and flour to butter mixture. Mix well.
Form smaller, flat cakes with some flour. Use floured hands to shape.
Fry in heated butter or oil until nicely brown on both sides.
Serve warm with sour cream.

recipes.name: Risotto with Mushrooms
recipes.subtitle: Albanian Main Course
recipes.description: Creamy risotto with fresh mushrooms and cheese

ingredients.item: bone stock or soup from cube

steps.instruction: Peel onion and chop finely. Heat oil a little and add onion.
Cook until nearly tender, then pour in wine. Cook together until it boils.
Trim mushrooms, wash and slice finely. Add to onion and cook together for a short while.
Pick over rice, wash and drain well. Add to mushrooms and fry together for a while.
Pour in soup (or lukewarm water). Add salt and pepper and stir slowly.
Simmer until rice is tender, about 15-20 minutes.
steps.tips: Rice should be creamy, not dry

steps.instruction: When cooked, stir in grated cheese and chopped parsley.
Serve immediately. Can also serve as light supper with fresh vegetables.

recipes.name: Stuffed Grape Vine Leaves
recipes.subtitle: Greek Appetizer
recipes.description: Delicate grape leaves filled with rice and herbs, cooked in lemon broth

steps.instruction: Cook slowly finely chopped onion in heated oil until tender.
Add picked-over and washed rice and fry shortly.
Add warm water, pistachios, chopped herbs, salt, pepper and some sugar. Mix well.
Add more warm water as needed and cook slowly for 10-15 minutes. Cool the filling.
Pour boiling water over grapevine leaves, let stand, then rinse with cold water and drain well.
Line bottom of cooking pan with several leaves. Place rest of leaves on board with bottom sides up.
Put spoonful of filling on each leaf, fold leaf corners over it and roll up. Place into dish.
Over dolmas pour lemon juice, melted butter and warm water.
Simmer for about 40-45 minutes. Cool and serve with lemon and egg sauce (avgholemono).
